meta.title: ASSETRA Private Investors | Off-market investment opportunities from €100,000
meta.description: A selective investment club for investors with €100,000+ in capital. Discounted off-market real estate, secured financings and business acquisitions in Slovakia and Czechia. Every opportunity comes with an investment memo including risks.

benefits.label: How membership works
benefits.intro: After free registration, we will send you a selection of interesting investment opportunities — property buyouts, real estate project financing, and acquisitions of established Slovak companies. Only when there is something that matches your profile.

earlyAccess.title: Early access
earlyAccess.text: We send you selected opportunities before they go public.

noCommitment.title: No commitments
noCommitment.text: Membership is free. No fees, no commissions. You respond only when you want to.

preferences.title: Your preferences
preferences.text: We only send what matches your profile — type, scope, and horizon.

discretion.title: Discretion
discretion.text: Specific details are shared under NDA. We do not share your data with anyone.

manifesto.label: Let's be honest
manifesto.p1: ASSETRA is not a big name today. We are a new investment group — no long track record, no billions under management. We won't pretend otherwise.
manifesto.p2: What we have is access. To properties and businesses that sell outside the open market — fast, discreetly and at a significant discount. We put our own capital into transactions, and for each one you receive a complete analysis including the risks and the scenario where things go wrong.
manifesto.p3: We don't ask for your trust upfront. It is built through the first transaction we do together.

intro: Membership is free and selective. It is intended for investors planning to allocate at least €100,000 to private markets over the next 24 months. Every application is reviewed individually — and not every one is approved.

offMarket.title: 01 — Off-Market Deal Flow
offMarket.text: Properties and businesses that never appear in listings. We source them directly from owners — from situations where speed and cash decide.

privateCredit.title: 02 — Private Credit
privateCredit.text: Participation in financings secured by a mortgage over property — with conservative LTV and a clear source of repayment.

coInvest.title: 03 — Co-Investments
coInvest.text: You enter specific transactions alongside us — undervalued properties and development projects, deal by deal, at your own choice.

memos.title: 04 — Investment Memos
memos.text: Every opportunity comes with an analysis: valuation, collateral, risks and downside scenario. No marketing brochures.

deal.label: What an opportunity looks like

type.label: Transaction type
type.value: Off-market apartment purchase — regional city, Slovakia

strategy.label: Strategy
strategy.value: Cash purchase within 14 days → legal cleanup → sale or rental

deal.disclaimer: Illustrative example of the structure — parameters differ with every transaction.
deal.whyText: In these situations the seller doesn't need the highest price — they need certainty and speed. Foreclosure, inheritance proceedings, divorce, stalled financing. We buy in cash and close in days, not months. The discount is the reward for speed and certainty, not a coincidence.
deal.memoNote: Specific opportunities, including the full investment memo — valuation, legal status, collateral, risks, downside scenario — are shared only with approved members, under NDA.

skin.title: Capital at stake
skin.text: We invest alongside you. We carry the transaction risk together with you — which is why we select hard.

direct.title: Direct investor, no commissions
direct.text: We are not a broker or a seller of third-party products. Membership is free — we earn on transactions, not on fees from you.

discretion.title: Discretion and a small circle
discretion.text: Transaction details are shared under NDA. We deliberately keep the club small — the capacity of individual transactions is limited.

process.heading: How we select opportunities
process.note: Only a fraction of the opportunities we review reaches members. We show process and risk management, not return promises.

form.heading: Membership application
form.title: ASSETRA Investor Application
form.description: Membership is free, but selective. Based on your application we assess whether we can bring you relevant opportunities. Selected applicants are invited to a short introductory investor call.
form.allocation: How much capital do you plan to allocate to private markets over the next 24 months? *
form.assets: Approximate value of your investable assets *
form.ticket: Typical size of a single investment *
form.interests: Which opportunities are you interested in? *
form.note: Submitting the application is free and does not commit you to anything.

consent: I consent to the processing of my personal data for the purpose of assessing my membership application and receiving investment opportunities, in line with the privacy policy. You can unsubscribe at any time.

success.title: Application received
success.text: Thank you. We will review your application and invite selected applicants to a short introductory investor call.
